notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating three 1/1 Squirrel and three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
